page.overview:
Who is Eskil Ryndarien?

Realmseer Eskil Ryndarien is one of the most powerful arcane practitioners in Tal'Dorei. As an NPC, he is played by Matthew Mercer.

Eskil is an older human man with round spectacles and a fringe of white hair around his balding top.

Eskil is grumpy, self-important, and unpersonable. Vex once called him a "crotchety old fuck." He usually does as he's asked in the end, but complains often and considers most tasks beneath him.

Eskil once worked within the circle of mages known as the Arcana Pansophical, serving as a Maker, but retired due to frustrations with the political aspects. Until the Chroma Conclave attacked, Eskil lived in Westruun atop his ominous Greystone Tower, attended by his manservant Jekt Wince.
